text:
maya: Quickstart sample fails when deployed to Cloudflare Workers during onboarding. Error: ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined. Also seeing TS errors about default export from the SDK. Anyone run into this?

deploy-bot: deploy failed for sample-worker (us-west) — Uncaught ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined

sam: Yup, this is the classic edge vs node stdlib mismatch. Our SDK still has a few spots that assume Buffer (base64 helpers) and a CJS consumer path that ends up requiring the CJS bundle in worker builds. Workers have no Buffer, process, or fs.

alex: Short-term workaround for folks on CF Workers: polyfill Buffer and force the ESM entry. Add at the top of your worker: 
```js
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
globalThis.Buffer = globalThis.Buffer || Buffer;
```
And import the SDK as an ESM namespace: 
```js
import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = Redwood.createClient({ fetch: globalThis.fetch });
```
That avoids require() paths and uses the platform fetch.

maya: thanks, alex. That fixed the runtime error but still get TS complaints in the sample template: "Module has no default export" when people do `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`.

tina: The typings are the problem — index.d.ts currently emits both `export =` and `export default` in different builds which trips up TS with `esModuleInterop: false`. Two options: update the d.ts to only export named exports, or update our quickstart template to recommend `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` and explain esModuleInterop. Short term I can add a note in the onboarding guide.

sam: Longer term we should: (1) make the SDK detect "edge" via a build flag and avoid node-only codepaths, (2) publish a pure-ESM edge build (no Buffer references) and an explicit CJS bundle for Node, and (3) tweak index.d.ts so ESM/CJS interop is consistent. I'll open a PR for bundler changes. @tina can you own the typings tweak?

tina: Yep, will file a PR for typings and a small README snippet recommending the polyfill approach for CF until we ship the ESM-edge bundle. Also adding a TS example showing `import * as Redwood` to avoid the error.

alex: Another gotcha — our auth retry layer uses a tiny base64 helper that called `Buffer.from(...).toString('base64')`. Replaced with web-friendly: `btoa(String.fromCharCode(...))` or `globalThis.atob` combos to avoid Buffer. We'll cover both in the PR.

maya: Can we also surface a quick check in the quickstart script that warns when deploying to an edge runtime and suggests the polyfill + import change? New users hit this and it kills onboarding. :disappointed_relieved:

sam: Good idea. I'll add a runtime-detect guard in the template generator and a link to the doc PR.

maya: Thanks all — saved my demo for tomorrow. Leaving the stack trace here for the follow-up issue: 
```
ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined
    at /worker/handler.js:45:12
    at async handler (/worker/handler.js:98:5)
```

alex: I'll post a short code snippet we can drop into the quickstart repo and link the issue once PRs are up.

maya: 👍
